_readme: Source of truth. A living cross-estate backlog of things AI agents have noticed are broken, missing, or worth improving while doing other work -- not a mirror of live metrics already visible in work-inbox/command-centre/hris-dashboard. Any agent can append an item here (see add_backlog_item.py) and push. build_roadmap.py reads this file, groups by area, and writes data/roadmap.json for the dashboard.

items.title: No persistent cross-brief item registry -- items drafted for one brief never propagate to others
items.recommendation: Build a shared item registry with a last-verified date per item, and a pre-finish check that scans every other brief's item set for anything that should also appear.

items.title: Organisational Structure Update (Simon Burford's 3-unit reorg proposal) drafted 18 Aug for the SK 1-1 brief, never reached the Roadmap brief
items.recommendation: Propagate manually now; root cause is meet-01, fixing that prevents recurrence.

items.title: ORCID-onboarding sub-thread inside DTP1092 untracked anywhere (open since Oct 2024)
items.recommendation: Give it its own tracked item on the Roadmap Master or fold explicitly into DTP1092's own status, rather than living only inside update-history prose.
items.source: build_roadmap.py DTP1092 update history, refreshed 21 Aug, commit c737180

items.title: SK 1-1 -- 2 pending prep items never pushed to the actual brief
items.recommendation: Push P1 (org-structure reorg) and P2 (Cority Applicant Data Import DOB format fix) into the brief before the next SK 1-1.

items.title: KPI Presentation -- unconfirmed whether June/July runs happened during Kevin's absence; kpi-definitions.md still a stub
items.recommendation: Confirm with Kevin directly whether June/July KPI runs happened; fill in kpi-definitions.md.

items.title: 7 Roadmap Master items overdue with no revised date confirmed (136 PeopleXD DPIA, DTP1334 H&S Management System, DTP1092 REF-via-ESS sub-thread, ITS1004 WFM Rollout, 179 SSO Migration, 174_b H&S Dashboards, 22_c/22_d Security Model Review)

items.source: Lauren sweep, 21 Aug 2026, cross-referenced against Roadmap Master

items.title: needs_reply classifier missed emails where Kevin wasn't the actual addressee (string-matched Exchange display name, not real SMTP To/Cc)
items.recommendation: Fixed -- Recipients/PropertyAccessor SMTP resolution, tested 5/5 live.
items.source: work-inbox main, commit c8ab371, deployed 20 Aug 2026

items.title: needs_reply classifier drops bare meeting-invite/no-content emails entirely (8 of 9 undrafted entries in one pass were just calendar boilerplate)
items.recommendation: Distinguish 'no real ask, correctly skip' from 'ask present but misread as an invite' -- not yet separated.

items.title: Items scroll out of the 50-newest-email pull window before being actioned (Quirke/Access Group case)
items.recommendation: Fix proposed, not built: persist items past the pull window until explicitly resolved.

items.title: needs_reply.json's own rolling window separately drops entries before they're drafted (NHS Pension tiers case) -- a 4th distinct class of needs_reply gap, possibly same mechanism as wi-03 but not confirmed identical
items.recommendation: Confirm whether wi-03 and wi-04 share a root cause before building two separate fixes.

items.title: Tasks get marked done without a written resolution recorded -- action log can end on an open TODO despite done:true
items.recommendation: Require a resolution note before a task can be marked done, or a confirmation step. Verified live example: task t027 (P5 Incident #11687334) is done:true, last action line is '[TODO] Review thread -- determine if Kevin holds relevant information...'. Note: t020 was also cited but was not found under that id in live data as of this check -- not independently confirmed, flagged rather than asserted.
items.source: command-centre data/tasks.json, task t027, live-checked 21 Aug 2026

items.title: command-centre's task schema has no 'owner' field at all, for any task
items.recommendation: Needs Kevin's explicit confirmation before adding -- not added unprompted per his own instruction at the time.

items.title: All 3 hris-change-requests are still Draft status -- none have ever progressed past drafting (oldest since 15 Jun 2026)
items.recommendation: Define a real CR lifecycle (Draft -> Approved -> In Progress -> Closed) and revisit each one's actual status against it.

items.title: 6 SAASIT tickets have gone stale with no escalation mechanism, oldest untouched 183 days
items.recommendation: A stale-ticket review/escalation step, similar to command-centre's staleness badge concept, doesn't exist for SAASIT tickets.

items.title: The .bat that pulls import_osm_report.py from GitHub is commit-pinned (SCRIPT_SHA), but that pin can silently go stale -- nothing enforces bumping it when the script changes
items.recommendation: Add an automated check (e.g. a CI step or a pre-commit hook) that fails if import_osm_report.py changes without SCRIPT_SHA also being bumped in the same change, rather than relying on every future session remembering the rule.

items.title: Cority Salesforce Community scrape (Source 2, uc.cority.com) still needs an authenticated login flow, Coveo article enumeration, and an image-placeholder safety check
items.recommendation: Scope and build the authenticated scrape path; ClickHelp side is already fully built/indexed.

items.title: Kevin's Guides section still has a broken JSON-blob pipeline that needs removing, superseded by the library-file approach

items.title: A mid-build 'git reset --hard' while redirecting this dashboard's repo destroyed uncommitted working files (recovered from tool-call history, nothing lost, but shouldn't have happened)
items.recommendation: Prefer committing before repointing a remote, or using a fresh clone/worktree, rather than reusing a working tree with staged-but-uncommitted files across a remote redirect.
